chunks: Who will turn away from the creed of Abraham but one dull of soul? We made him the chosen one here in the world, and one of the best in the world to come,

key_terms.سَفِهَ نَفْسَهُ: One who is dull of soul or simple-minded

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to turn away from the creed of Abraham?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Fitrah* (innate disposition), portraying Ibrahim’s monotheism as the natural state of humanity that the foolish (*safih*) abandon due to ignorance. The phrase 'chose him in the world' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi to signify his unique spiritual rank and prophetic authority during his earthly life, reinforcing his status as *Imam* and *Khalilullah*. This underscores the continuity of the pure creed (*Millat Ibrahim*) through the Ahl al-Bayt, who are seen as the true inheritors of his legacy.
